parsed.name: 泰克 DPO4104 数字示波器
parsed.description: 泰克 DPO4104 是一款多通道数字示波器，可控制采集运行方式、采集长度、波形传输数据源与数据宽度，并读取通道、参考通道和数学运算波形，适用于实验中的电信号观测与波形分析。
parsed.description_en: The Tektronix DPO4104 is a multi-channel digital oscilloscope that can control acquisition state, acquisition length, waveform transfer source, and data width, and can read channel, reference, and math waveforms for electrical signal observation and waveform analysis in laboratory experiments.
